frontier_selector.why: The specific pattern of symmetric hypoautofluorescent lesions with hyperautofluorescent borders in the central macula bilaterally on FAF imaging, along with the OCT and ff-ERG findings, decided it.

support_spans: fundus autofluorescence (FAF) imaging demonstrated symmetric hypoautofluorescent lesions with hyperautofluorescent borders in the central macula bilaterally
optical coherence tomography (OCT) showed thinning of the outer nuclear layer in the fovea, partial preservation of the ellipsoid zone, and a normal retinal nerve fiber layer
full-field electroretinography (ff-ERG) revealed normal scotopic responses but attenuated photopic responses and 30-Hz flicker responses with delayed implicit times in both eyes
